latest_release.body:
### Enhancements:

- [19195](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/opencti/issues/19195) feat(graph): Run an enrichment connector from the investigation graph’s right-click menu

### Bug Fixes:

- [#19610](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/opencti/issues/19610) perf(engine): drop redundant clauses from the access filters added to every search
- [#18298](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/opencti/issues/18298) fix(background-task): Avoid creating large query background tasks without filters
- [#19702](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/opencti/issues/19702) fix(public-dashboards): widgets of a public dashboard are shorter than in the dashboard they were laid out in
- [#19676](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/opencti/issues/19676) fix(scope): activity log improvements
- [#19629](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/opencti/issues/19629) fix(cache): an edit that lands while the cache is loading is lost, so a started playbook may never run
- [#18075](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/opencti/issues/18075) fix(user): normalize email to avoid duplicate
- [#13236](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/opencti/issues/13236) fix(data-sharing): new relationship types are breaking existing OpenCTI streams

----
